name: @pipeworx/mcp-wisconsin-code

tools.name: wi_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Wisconsin Statutes — Wisconsin state law — by citation. "Wis. Stat. 940.01" is first-degree intentional homicide. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Wisconsin Statute 940.01 say" or to check a Wisconsin statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "940.01" (first-degree intentional homicide) or "346.63" (OWI).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wisconsin-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wisconsin-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
